name: migration-studio
description: Developer shortcuts. Everything runs in Docker, so this file has no dependencies.

scripts.seed: docker compose run --rm api python -m data.generator.main --load
scripts.verify: docker compose run --rm api python -m data.generator.verify
scripts.demo: docker compose --profile demo up --build db api demo
scripts.lint:api: docker compose run --rm api sh -c "ruff check /workspace/apps/api /workspace/data /workspace/engines && mypy app"
scripts.test:web: docker compose run --rm --no-deps web sh -c "npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm test"
scripts.lint:web: docker compose run --rm --no-deps web sh -c "npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run lint && npm run typecheck"
scripts.sim: docker compose -f docker-compose.azure.yml up --build -d --wait db blob api web && docker compose -f docker-compose.azure.yml run --rm --build seed
scripts.qe:dev: docker compose -f docker-compose.qe.yml up --build qe-db qe-api qe-web module
scripts.qe:verify: docker compose -f docker-compose.qe.yml run --rm --no-deps qe-api sh -c "cd /workspace && python -m qe.tools.verify --lab"
scripts.qe:test:api: docker compose -f docker-compose.qe.yml run --rm qe-api pytest
scripts.qe:record: docker compose -f docker-compose.qe.yml exec -w /workspace qe-api python -m qe.engines.agents.record
scripts.qe:generate: docker compose -f docker-compose.qe.yml exec -w /workspace qe-api python -m qe.engines.agents.generate
scripts.qe:maintain: docker compose -f docker-compose.qe.yml exec -w /workspace qe-api python -m qe.engines.agents.maintain
scripts.qe:reset: docker compose -f docker-compose.qe.yml exec -w /workspace/apps/qe-api qe-api python -m app.reset
